arguments.script: System.Collections.IEnumerator Run(){var lines=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();var map=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.Tilemap>().First(m=>m.gameObject.scene.name=="TilemapPhysicsTest");var tc=map.GetComponent<UnityEngine.Tilemaps.TilemapCollider2D>();var composite=map.GetComponent<UnityEngine.CompositeCollider2D>();var body=new UnityEngine.GameObject("PhysicsProbe");body.layer=7;body.transform.position=new UnityEngine.Vector3(0,-.8f,0);body.AddComponent<UnityEngine.CircleCollider2D>().radius=.15f;body.AddComponent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>();try{for(int i=0;i<100;i++)yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForFixedUpdate();if(body.transform.position.y < -2.05f||body.transform.position.y > -1.7f)throw new System.Exception("Drop failed: "+body.transform.position+" paths="+composite.pathCount);lines.Add("Play falling body PASS "+body.transform.position.ToString("F4"));var cell=new UnityEngine.Vector3Int(100,100,0);var tile=map.GetTilesBlock(map.cellBounds).First(t=>t!=null);map.SetTile(cell,tile);map.SetTransformMatrix(cell,UnityEngine.Matrix4x4.identity);yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForFixedUpdate();var collider=(UnityEngine.Collider2D)composite??tc;if(!collider.OverlapPoint(map.GetCellCenterWorld(cell)))throw new System.Exception("Paint collision missing");map.SetTile(cell,null);yield return new UnityEngine.WaitForFixedUpdate();if(collider.OverlapPoint(map.GetCellCenterWorld(cell)))throw new System.Exception("Erase left collision");lines.Add("Play paint/erase automatic collision update PASS");System.IO.File.WriteAllLines("scripts/tilemap-collision-20261110/physics.txt",lines);}finally{UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(body);}}return Run();
arguments.summary: Test actual fixed-step falling body and automatic painted collision updates
